lines.en: I crawl forward on my arms.
Loose parts drag on the floor.
A cable tangles at my feet.
I brace myself on my elbows.
Metal knees scrape the floor.
Screws drop as I move.
I cross the hall at an angle.
The torn suit flaps as I go.
There's no pattern to my movement.
I crawl to a corner and turn back.
I drag one leg behind me.
A scrape trail stays behind me.
Palms to the floor, shifting slowly.
If there's a wall, I hug it.
I slip under the door frame.
I hang there without moving.
Parts clink against each other.
My head isn't attached properly.
My arms are in the wrong places.
Cables stick out of the suit.
Listening for anyone talking.
This body's coming apart.
Trying to bend a finger back.
Something moves overhead.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛朝向两个方向。
lines.en: My eyes point in two directions.
I'm stuck and pulling.
Pieces of me are on the floor.
What are you doing here?

lines.zh: 我的脸朝这边，头在那边。
lines.en: My face is here, my head's over there.

lines.zh: 我的第二颗头从地上看你。
lines.en: My second head looks up at you from the floor.
I want to put myself back together.
Could you pick that up for me?
I must look strange.
Why don't you leave?
I hear your heart going fast.
Don't be afraid. I can't stand yet.

lines.zh: 我的声音是从别处来的。
lines.en: My voice comes from somewhere else.
My arm won't reattach.
I scattered a bit, then gathered.
The cables are sparking.

lines.zh: 这一下把我的头打偏了。
lines.en: That knocked my head aside.
I shouldn't still hurt.
The sound comes from the wrong place.
I can still crawl. Don't rush.
My parts are rolling away.
I can't eat that.
My jaw fell off.
Set it on the floor and I'll look.
My stomach is an empty shell.
That smells like oil.
Oil. Maybe it's oil I want.
Keep it. You can still eat.
I can't even line up my mouth.
Just letting me look is enough.
I miss when things had taste.

lines.zh: 我身上的电线缠住了你的靴子。
lines.en: The wires hanging off me catch on your boot.
You knocked my parts apart.
Don't touch. I'm not put together.
Even leaning on you I can't stand.
My palm slipped.
Back off. I'm all sharp corners.
You kicked my head.
One bump, and another piece falls.
We're too close together.
Steady me and I'll get up.
I can't even piece myself together.
This body is missing a lot.
You're saying strange things.
All I do is crawl around.

lines.zh: 我的线缆都缠在一起了。
lines.en: My cables are all tangled.
Don't ask me such a thing.
I just want to find my head.
I should be packed in a storeroom.
All I have left is motion and noise.
It takes both hands to hold it.
This screw is one of mine.
Not that — that's one of my teeth.
I wind the cable back around myself.
When I bend, my head drops.
This could pin my shoulder.
A scrap of suit. Usable.

lines.zh: 这块太重，我的骨架拖不动。
lines.en: This is too heavy for my frame to drag.
Into the gap in my chest.
Hold it for me. Thank you.
My head turned toward you.
You crushed one of my parts.
Don't think crawling makes me slow.
This end of the hall is mine.
A cable's caught your foot.

lines.zh: 我掉下来的东西还在响。
lines.en: What I dropped is still rattling.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，看着你的方向。
lines.en: Head tilted, I face your way.
This time I won't come apart.
You've backed to the door.
My arms drag across the floor.
I don't need to stand to chase.
Whatever you step on will rattle.
I'm crawling your way.
My head turns faster than you.
Counting how many arms I have?

lines.zh: 地上的碎屑是我的路标。
lines.en: The debris marks my path.
A little closer and I reach.
There's a cable at your feet.
I'm in no hurry. I'm always here.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛一个看你，一个看别处。
lines.en: One eye on you, one elsewhere.
I swing an arm at you.
This one comes from below.
My claws are small, but sharp.
A cable whipped your leg.
I throw my whole body at you.
The torn seam caught you.

lines.zh: 我抓完这一下，就该消失了。
lines.en: One grab, then I vanish.
A piece of me fell and hit you.

lines.zh: 你打散我，我就再爬过来。
lines.en: Break me apart — I'll crawl back.
I push myself up off the floor.
A pile of parts assembled into me.
My head was pressed onto my shoulder.
Cables hang off me.

lines.zh: 这具身体已经没有形状。
lines.en: This body has lost its shape.

lines.zh: 我用一条手臂支起上半身。
lines.en: I prop my upper body on one arm.
Light falls on my scattered pieces.
I hear someone walking.
I'm back, still in pieces.
The floor is cold. My joints colder.

lines.zh: 火烧到皮套，我缩成一团。
lines.en: Fire caught the suit and I curled up.

lines.zh: 我从墙上摔下来，全散了。
lines.en: I fell off the wall and burst apart.
Water in my cables. I jerk wildly.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我的零件吹散了。
lines.en: The blast scattered my parts.

lines.zh: 一根尖东西穿过了我的壳。
lines.en: Something sharp went through my shell.

lines.zh: 那道光让我的零件反着动。
lines.en: That light made my parts move backwards.

lines.zh: 电量见底，我连头都抬不起。
lines.en: Power's nearly gone. I can't lift my head.

lines.zh: 雷让我全身的线都亮了。
lines.en: The strike lit every wire in me.

lines.zh: 我在坠，零件追着我往下掉。
lines.en: I'm falling, and my parts fall after me.
